patch_list: Auto-skip
Skips the parts you choose: Apple's promos for other titles, recaps, and intros.
Auto-skip (Android TV)
Presses Skip for you on the parts you choose: Apple's promos for other titles, recaps, and intros.
Block analytics & tracking
Stops Apple's usage metrics, such as the pages you view and what you play.
Block analytics & tracking (Android TV)
Reduces Apple's usage metrics and stops playback reports in the Android TV app. The app also stops downloading updates to its screens between app updates.
Disable auto-updates
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Disable up next
Lets the credits play full screen, instead of shrinking the video into a corner to show the next episode or a recommendation.
Hide device identifiers
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hide player overlays
Hides the overlays you choose: the rating card when a title starts, product placement notices, and photosensitivity and high-motion warnings.
Hide rating prompt
Stops the "Enjoying Apple TV?" review prompt.
Hide rating prompt (Android TV)
Stops the review prompt from Google Play in the Android TV app.
Show release times
Shows the time in your time zone when an upcoming episode or title is released.
Show release times (Android TV)
Shows the day and time in your time zone when an upcoming episode or title is released.
Skip ads
Stops the ad interstitials in on-demand videos.
Spoof carrier
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
